summary.intent: Complete phase 43 (fuse-write-durability) by running a CodeRabbit review, cross-checking and fixing all 8 documented criticals from the existing 43-REVIEW.md, running a /simplify pass, and shipping the phase as a PR.
summary.outcome: All 8 CR criticals verified and closed (CR-03 TEE-key fallback and CR-04 inode mutation ordering fixed), /simplify pass applied 3 cleanups and deferred 6 larger refactors as tracked todos, and PR #487 was created against main.

repo: Phase 43 is branch `feat/fuse-write-durability`; branch naming follows `feat/<phase-slug>` convention discoverable via `.planning/phases/` dir listing.
CI gates on `cargo check --features winfsp` and `cargo check --features fuse` separately (ci.yml:557–605); winfsp path cannot be compiled on macOS so CI is the only verification gate for those edits.
No `cargo fmt` or `cargo clippy` CI gate exists — the codebase is not uniformly rustfmt-styled; running fmt would reformat the entire repo.
Commits require 1Password SSH signing; the signer can wedge with 'failed to fill whole buffer' after a failed attempt and requires restarting the 1Password app to recover.
An 'Entire' pre-push hook runs checkpoint sync before every push, adding latency to all push operations.

Phase 42 was squash-merged as PR #485; the branch predating that squash still contains phase-42 commits in its log, but the net diff against `origin/main` (158addcc) is phase-43-only — confirmed safe for a squash-merge PR.
PR title must pass a `pr-title` CI gate enforcing conventional commit format.
`.planning/` directory is excluded from the markdownlint pre-commit hook.
The GSD ship workflow gates strictly on verification status `passed`; `human_needed` blocks PR creation even when all automated checks pass.
The `gsd_run query commit` tool respects `commit_docs` config and gitignore; used for planning-doc commits throughout.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: error fallback used `encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default()` as the child IPNS key journal value, writing a TEE-wrapped key into the user-key field — replay cannot unwrap with the user's private key. Fixed to warn + `String::new()` so replay parks instead of bricking.
CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE-key fallback in child IPNS key journal write. Fixed symmetrically.

`wrap_key` called as `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` while rest of file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — latent compile error if winfsp path is not built in CI. Fixed to use `ecies::wrap_key` consistently.
Parent IPNS key wrap failure swallowed via `.ok()` → empty key, silently degrading the journal entry. Hardened to warn on failure across all 6 sibling IPNS-key wrap sites.

CR-04: in-memory mutations (inode.kind @765, pending_content @782, queue_publish @794) all occurred before `journal.put` — a prepare/journal failure left inode mutated and a queued publish outstanding with no rollback path. Fixed by deferring all three mutations until after the journal fsync commits.
Case-sensitive `"not found"` string match for first-publish detection in replay; a reworded error silently flips the branch. Deferred as typed-error refactor todo.
Folder key and file content key wraps already fail-fast with `?` — correct pattern, no silent degradation. Left unchanged.
Duplicated per-variant `sort_by_key` match on `JournalOp`; added `created_at_ms()` accessor method to collapse it.
Dead `journal_entry_id` field in `UploadSpawnParams` — struct field populated, destructured, then only used as `let _` suppressor. Removed entirely.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI can be scoped to a phase diff using `--from-sha <merge-base>` flag; the merge-base is found with `git merge-base main HEAD`.
Parallel verification agents (one per critical finding) are an effective pattern for cross-checking a review doc against current code after commits have landed.
CR-04-style 'defer mutations past the commit point' is cleaner than snapshot-rollback when the in-flight operation (queue_publish) has no clean undo API.
/simplify runs 4 parallel agents (reuse/simplification/efficiency/altitude); findings should be triaged against dep-creep and security-sensitive paths before applying.
Before creating a PR from a long-lived branch, verify the actual `git diff origin/main...HEAD` scope — a stale local `main` ref can make the diff look wrong even when the PR scope is clean.
The GSD ship workflow requires updating VERIFICATION.md manually to `passed` when UAT was completed but not recorded; the gate doesn't auto-pass on human confirmation.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' error after a failed signing attempt; required restarting 1Password app to recover — caused two wasted commit retries.
GitHub connectivity timeout (Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 75s) interrupted the push mid-session, requiring a manual retry after confirming reachability.
winfsp path cannot be compiled locally on macOS, so all Windows-path edits (CR-03, CR-04, simplify C) could only be verified by inspection or CI — adds risk to the most security-sensitive path.
Stale local `main` ref caused initial confusion about PR scope (appeared to include phase 42 commits); had to diff against `origin/main` to confirm phase-43-only net diff.
Background task output requires polling via Read tool on the output file path — no direct stdout streaming for long-running cargo/git operations.
Combined commit-and-push command did not push when the commit itself failed first; the push step was silently skipped, requiring a separate explicit push.
open_items: Consolidate duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction (~150 lines) into shared `CipherBoxFS` methods in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` — security-sensitive (D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved), requires winfsp CI gate.
Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly + `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper across ~5 producer sites and 3 replay sites.

Extract shared journal-dir path + `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES=5` helper — triplicated across `fuse/mod.rs`, `fuse/windows/mod.rs`, `commands/sync.rs`; a mismatch would point sync daemon at a different journal than the FUSE mount (CR-07 footgun). Needs new `dirs` dep in `crates/sdk`.

Have `replay_upload_entry` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a `cas_publish_parent` helper — replay re-inlines ~70+40 lines that also exist in `write_ops.rs` and `platform/windows/write_ops.rs`.

Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` with a `HashMap<ipns_name, folder_key>` — currently re-walks the vault tree from root per entry; mount-time replay is super-linear when multiple entries share a parent.

Replace `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` branch in replay first-publish detection with a typed `Result<Option<u64>>` or `NotFound` variant from `resolve_sequence` — touches `PublishCoordinator` and all its callers.
No unit test asserts CR-04 behavior ('prepare failure mutates no in-memory state') — hard to force `journal.put` failure in tests; noted as coverage gap.
PR #487 CI run is the first real compile of the winfsp CR-03/CR-04/simplify edits.
